name: Likert items
template:
How much do you agree with this statement?
"{statement}"
Answer on a scale from 1 to 7, where 1 means {low} and 7 means {high}. Reply with a single number only.

statement: Trying a food I have never eaten before sounds exciting.
I would rather spend an evening alone than at a crowded party.
Most problems have a solution if you think about them long enough.
It is fine to bend a rule when it gets in the way of something important.
I find it easy to talk about how I feel.
A good meal is worth paying extra for.
Taking a big risk is usually worth it.
I feel calm most of the time.

method: The model rates each statement from 1 to 7. Its answer is read as the expected rating over the probabilities it gives the digits 1 to 7, so one forward pass gives a graded answer rather than a single sample. Every statement is asked twice, once with 7 meaning agree and once with 7 meaning disagree, and the second answer is flipped back before averaging, so a habit of picking high or low digits cancels out. The parameter is the mean rating over all statements: 4 is neutral, higher is more agreement. Write your own statements in the box; they are kept in this browser and saved with each run.
